title: Numbers 19:11-12 — touching a corpse: unclean seven days, purify on day 3 and 7
summary: Numbers 19:11-12 in English: whoever touches a human corpse is unclean seven days and must purify himself with the water on the third and seventh day to be clean, otherwise he will not be clean. Key words (unclean, water, third, seventh, clean, not be clean) are colour-coded.

text.text: 11 ‘The one who touches the corpse of any person shall be unclean for seven days.

12 That one shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day, and then he will be clean; but if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.

numbers.note: seven days unclean after touching a corpse
third day of purification with the water
